from queue import Queue


def set_color(v, c):
    q = Queue()
    q.put(v)
    color[v - 1] = c
    while not q.empty():
        t = q.get()
        for u in graph[t - 1]:
            q.put(u)
            color[u - 1] = c


def BFS(v):
    q = Queue()
    q.put(v)
    set_color(v, c[v - 1])
    count = 1
    while not q.empty():
        t = q.get()
        for u in graph[t - 1]:
            q.put(u)
            if color[u - 1] != c[u - 1]:
                set_color(u, c[u - 1])
                count += 1
    return count

p = list(map(int, input().split()))
c = list(map(int, input().split()))
lock = set()
f = [None] * n


def bfs(graph, start, color):
    visited, queue = set(), [start]
    while queue:
        vertex = queue.pop(0)
        f[vertex] = color
        if vertex not in visited and vertex not in lock:
            visited.add(vertex)
            queue.extend(graph[vertex] - visited)
    return visited


graph = [set() for i in range(n)]
for i in range(n - 1):
    graph[i + 1].add(p[i] - 1)
    graph[p[i] - 1].add(i + 1)

ans = 0
for i in range(n):
    if f[i] != c[i]:
        bfs(graph, i, c[i])
        lock.add(i)
        ans += 1
